serverUrl.label: Memory Server URL
serverUrl.help: URL of the Memolo memory server (supports ${MEMOLO_SERVER_URL})

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.help: API key for authentication (supports ${MEMOLO_API_KEY} env var)

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store conversation exchanges after each agent turn

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum number of memories to retrieve during auto-recall

includeOtherAgents.label: Include Other Agents
includeOtherAgents.help: Include memories from other agents during recall (cross-agent memory)

tags.label: Default Tags
tags.help: Comma-separated default tags to attach to stored memories
